description: Generate a video (talking-head parity via Seedance native audio) from a prompt and optional reference images.

caption_placement.description: Where captions sit. Defaults per style: chunk/highlight → center, subtitle → bottom.

caption_style.description: Caption look. chunk = 2–4 words per line, centered, bold with a heavy outline (the standard TikTok/Reels style). highlight = the same block with the active word lit in colour (the Hormozi/retention style). subtitle = one clean line at the bottom (cinematic / YouTube).

captions.description: Burn spoken-word captions into the video. When true the run returns two files: output[0] is captioned, output[1] is the original uncaptioned video.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Allowed values depend on model — seedance-2: 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15; kling-3: 3, 5, 8, 10, 15.

influencer.description: Slug of a saved influencer — the server attaches its portrait + character sheet as references and prepends its appearance description to the prompt.

owns_references.description: Required true when reference_images are attached (likeness consent).

name: make_video

run_id.description: Poll this id with get_run for status + output URLs.
